meta.site_tagline: Public program catalog and partner network for veteran transition support.
meta.index_summary: Structured pathways for housing stability, referrals, and transition readiness.

items.name: Veteran Housing Stability
items.summary: Short-term housing placement, benefits navigation, and landlord coordination for veterans at risk of displacement.
items.eligibility: Veterans and families experiencing housing instability or pending eviction.
items.how_to_apply: Complete the ShieldMate intake and provide residency documentation for a housing review.

items.name: Referral Navigation
items.summary: Guided referrals to vetted partners for employment, legal, health, and family support.
items.eligibility: Veterans, spouses, and caregivers seeking coordinated services.
items.how_to_apply: Submit a referral request and authorize data sharing for partner intake.

items.name: Transition Readiness
items.summary: Career planning, documentation prep, and benefits readiness for service members in transition.
items.eligibility: Active-duty members and veterans within 24 months of transition.
items.how_to_apply: Schedule a readiness session through ShieldMate and upload required service records.
